title: Erhu Signal (二胡信号) - EAST ASIA / CHINA: ERHU SIGNAL
style:
```
[style: Chinese erhu jiangnan, pipa silk road triplet runs, guzheng glissando, muyu wooden fish percussion, 4/4 with swing 8th triplet interplay, Silk Road ancient music modern, Mandarin spoken verses English chorus, two-string signal metaphor, no Western harmony structure, traditional pentatonic Chinese melody, signal transmission theme, V4_5ALL]
```
lyrics:
``
[INTRO — erhu solo, traditional jiangnan xiaodiao style]
(Mandarin) 二胡 — two strings / that is all you need

[VERSE 1 — pipa enters bar 3, muyu marks every beat]
(Mandarin) 两根弦 — two strings
(English)  All the signal needs
(Mandarin) 一把弓 — one bow
(English)  That draws across the breeze

The erhu holds the melody / straight and four-beat clean
The pipa fires triplets underneath / the swing between
The guzheng slides its glissando / from one end to the other
The muyu marks each beat exactly / every beat a brother

(Mandarin) 信号 — signal
(English)  On two strings
(Mandarin) 传达 — transmitted
(English)  Everything

[PRE-CHORUS — guzheng glissando full length]
(Mandarin) 听 — listen
(English)  Two strings
(Mandarin) 感受 — feel
(English)  The signal rings

[CHORUS — full ensemble, muyu prominent]
Erhu signal — two strings to the sky
Pipa triplet under — duple meets the eye
Guzheng slides the bridge — between the old and new
The signal was in China — long before it came to you

(Mandarin) 古老 — ancient
(English)  The two-string wire
(Mandarin) 永恒 — eternal
(English)  Never to retire

[VERSE 2 — pipa solo, 8 bars, full triplet runs]
The pipa has been playing for two thousand years
It crossed the Silk Road from Persia to the Tang court
It arrived with its strange bent-back neck
And China made it its own

The signal travels — it does not belong to one place
It arrives, it changes, it stays

(Mandarin) 变化 — transformation
(English)  The signal adapts
(Mandarin) 不变 — unchanged
(English)  The signal stays intact

[BRIDGE — erhu and guzheng duet, pipa silent]
Two strings / twenty-one strings
One bow / twenty-one fingers
The signal between them: silence
That is the swing

[FINAL CHORUS — doubled, pipa and erhu in dialogue]
Erhu signal — two strings to the sky

[OUTRO — erhu single long tone, muyu three strikes to close]
(Mandarin) 再见 — farewell
(English)  Signal transmitted
